question: When will Anthropic be publicly traded?

calls.reasoning: Public S-1 filed Oct 26, S-1/A Nov 2 with price range blank. Reports (Bloomberg/WSJ/Reuters) say the roadshow starts the week of Nov 9 and the listing targets the week of Nov 16. CoinDesk reported pricing Nov 19-20; SpaceX's 23-day filing-to-trade pace implies Nov 18. Earliest legal trade is Nov 16, but that needs about a 4-day roadshow for a ~$100B deal, so I discount it. The Nov 5-6 AI selloff cut valuation talk to $1.0-1.3T and some investors mention a delay, so meaningful mass sits on Not before December. Polymarket cumulative ladder (~$7M volume): by Nov17 15%, by Nov20 68%, by Nov25 79%, by Nov30 81%, implying ~15/53/11/2/19. Its contract closely matches but I could not fully verify whether it resolves on first trade. I shade Before Nov 18 down and delay up relative to it.

Checks: (1) searches show Polymarket's date market moved toward Nov 25 (30%) over Nov 20 (27%), and 'by Nov 20' fell from 63.5% to 44.5%, so Run 1's ~53% for Nov 18-20 is outdated; (2) still no price range filed as of Nov 9 (FinanceFeeds/decodethefuture), which rules out Nov 16-17 as plausible; (3) Nov 5 selloff dropped year-end/Nov 30 odds to 77%/68%, but the current harness snapshot shows 0.87/0.81, consistent with ~18-19% delay. Roadshow length remains a judgment call; I lean Nov 18-20 but give Nov 23-25 substantial weight.
